row 4: BIS Product Certification — Official FAQ (28 Q&A): Q1 | Unnamed: 1: What is a licence? | Unnamed: 2: Licence means a licence granted under Section 13 of BIS Act 2016 to use a specified Standard Mark in relation to any goods or article which conforms to a standard.
row 5: BIS Product Certification — Official FAQ (28 Q&A): Q2 | Unnamed: 1: I am a manufacturer and want to apply for a BIS product certification licence but don't know the corresponding IS number. How do I proceed? | Unnamed: 2: Search for the Indian Standard against a product at https://www.manakonline.in/MANAK/ApplicationLicenceRelatedrpt. If not found, send a query to the concerned BIS technical department via the BIS website.
row 6: BIS Product Certification — Official FAQ (28 Q&A): Q3 | Unnamed: 1: For which products is a BIS licence compulsory? | Unnamed: 2: Products are brought under compulsory certification by the Central Government under the BIS Act, 2016 or other Acts. The list is at bis.gov.in/product-certification/products-under-compulsory-certification/. If your product is on that list, a BIS licence is compulsory.
row 7: BIS Product Certification — Official FAQ (28 Q&A): Q4 | Unnamed: 1: What are the essential requirements for a manufacturer to apply for a BIS licence? | Unnamed: 2: The manufacturer must have the requisite manufacturing infrastructure, appropriate process controls, quality control and testing capabilities as per the relevant Indian Standard, and the product must conform to all requirements laid down in that standard.
row 8: BIS Product Certification — Official FAQ (28 Q&A): Q5 | Unnamed: 1: How does BIS grant the licence? | Unnamed: 2: BIS assesses manufacturing infrastructure, process controls, quality control and testing capabilities via a factory visit, and establishes conformity to the standard through third-party lab testing, in-factory testing, or both.
row 9: BIS Product Certification — Official FAQ (28 Q&A): Q6 | Unnamed: 1: What is the procedure for obtaining a BIS licence to use the Standard Mark? | Unnamed: 2: Two options exist for obtaining a product certification licence under Scheme-I; see the Guidelines for Grant of Licence for details.
row 10: BIS Product Certification — Official FAQ (28 Q&A): Q7 | Unnamed: 1: Where do I submit my application? | Unnamed: 2: BIS accepts product certification applications online only (including payments) via www.manakonline.in. Review the applicant user manual and portal FAQs before registering.
row 11: BIS Product Certification — Official FAQ (28 Q&A): Q8 | Unnamed: 1: Are technical guidelines available for products under the Product Certification Scheme? | Unnamed: 2: Yes — 'Product Manuals' cover sampling guidelines, test equipment lists, Scheme of Inspection and Testing (SIT), and scope description. Find them under Conformity Assessment > Product Certification > Product Specific Guidelines > Product Manuals.
row 12: BIS Product Certification — Official FAQ (28 Q&A): Q9 | Unnamed: 1: If Product Manual/SIT/grouping guidelines or marking fee for my product aren't yet defined, can I still get a licence? | Unnamed: 2: Yes — you may be the first applicant for a new product ('All India First Licence'). Basic principles and procedure remain the same with specific relaxations; BIS interacts with you to define product-specific guidelines and fee rate.
row 13: BIS Product Certification — Official FAQ (28 Q&A): Q10 | Unnamed: 1: Can I submit one application for different products/Standards at the same factory? | Unnamed: 2: No — a separate application is required for each product and Indian Standard, even at the same factory location.

row 16: BIS Product Certification — Official FAQ (28 Q&A): Q13 | Unnamed: 1: How long do test reports remain valid for grant of licence under Option-2? | Unnamed: 2: Generally not more than 90 days old.
row 17: BIS Product Certification — Official FAQ (28 Q&A): Q14 | Unnamed: 1: What fees apply for a certification licence? | Unnamed: 2: Application fee Rs. 1,000; inspection fee Rs. 7,000 per man-day before the preliminary inspection; after grant, annual licence fee Rs. 1,000 plus the minimum marking fee specified for the product (Annexure I of Scheme-I, BIS Conformity Assessment Regulations 2018, as amended 2020).
row 18: BIS Product Certification — Official FAQ (28 Q&A): Q15 | Unnamed: 1: What is the timeline for grant of a BIS product certification licence? | Unnamed: 2: Generally about one month under Option-2 and about four months under Option-1 from receipt of a complete application, subject to delays in queries, inspections, sample deposition, and fee dues.
row 19: BIS Product Certification — Official FAQ (28 Q&A): Q16 | Unnamed: 1: What are the conditions of a BIS licence to use a Standard Mark? | Unnamed: 2: As set out in Regulation 6 of the BIS (Conformity Assessment) Regulations, 2018.
row 20: BIS Product Certification — Official FAQ (28 Q&A): Q17 | Unnamed: 1: What are the punitive provisions for non-compliance with licence conditions? | Unnamed: 2: The licence may be cancelled by the Bureau under Regulation 11 of the BIS (Conformity Assessment) Regulations, 2018.
row 21: BIS Product Certification — Official FAQ (28 Q&A): Q18 | Unnamed: 1: What is the validity of a BIS product certification licence? | Unnamed: 2: Initially up to two years under Scheme-I, valid only for the varieties in the licence; renewable up to five years from the last validity date on application with the requisite fee and documents.

row 22: BIS Product Certification — Official FAQ (28 Q&A): Q19 | Unnamed: 1: How does one apply for renewal of a licence? | Unnamed: 2: Through the 'manakonline' online portal dashboard, with production details for the relevant period (to calculate marking fee) and the applicable renewal fee.
row 23: BIS Product Certification — Official FAQ (28 Q&A): Q20 | Unnamed: 1: What is deferment of a licence, and when does it happen? | Unnamed: 2: Renewal can be deferred under Regulation 8 of the BIS (Conformity Assessment) Regulations, 2018, if the renewal application/fee is not received by the licence's last validity date, or if the licence is under suspension.
row 24: BIS Product Certification — Official FAQ (28 Q&A): Q21 | Unnamed: 1: Does BIS carry out surveillance on my licence regularly? | Unnamed: 2: Yes — surprise factory surveillance inspections verify continued infrastructure, process controls, quality control, testing capability and product conformity; BIS also conducts market surveillance by purchasing ISI-marked samples for third-party testing.
row 25: BIS Product Certification — Official FAQ (28 Q&A): Q22 | Unnamed: 1: What are the duties of a licence holder regarding factory surveillance? | Unnamed: 2: Extend cooperation to BIS/agent personnel, share relevant records, facilitate in-factory testing and sample drawal, and deposit samples to the designated laboratory as advised.
row 26: BIS Product Certification — Official FAQ (28 Q&A): Q23/Q24 | Unnamed: 1: Can one product licence be used for all varieties made at the factory? | Unnamed: 2: No — one licence covers one product/one Indian Standard (though it may cover multiple varieties/grades/sizes specified in the standard); use is limited to the 'Scope of licence' granted. Scope changes require a separate application under the Guideline for Change in Scope of Licence.
row 27: BIS Product Certification — Official FAQ (28 Q&A): Q25 | Unnamed: 1: What is the procedure for intimating a change of address or shifting of the manufacturing unit? | Unnamed: 2: The licensee must inform BIS of the intended shift with documents for the new premises, suspend use of the Standard Mark on relocation (with intimation to BIS), and BIS revokes the suspension after verifying old/new premises per Scheme-I paragraph 11(3)&(4).
row 28: BIS Product Certification — Official FAQ (28 Q&A): Q26 | Unnamed: 1: When can a licence be suspended? | Unnamed: 2: Under paragraph 11 of Scheme-I and Regulation 10 of the BIS (Conformity Assessment) Regulations, 2018.
row 29: BIS Product Certification — Official FAQ (28 Q&A): Q27 | Unnamed: 1: When can a licence be cancelled? | Unnamed: 2: Under Regulation 11 of the BIS (Conformity Assessment) Regulations, 2018.
row 30: BIS Product Certification — Official FAQ (28 Q&A): Q28 | Unnamed: 1: How can a BIS licensee participate in standard formulation/revision? | Unnamed: 2: By becoming a member of the relevant technical committee, or by sending comments to the concerned technical department via mail or the BIS website.

row 7: BIS Product Certification — Official FAQ (28 Q&A): Q4 | Unnamed: 1: What are the essential requirements for a manufacturer to apply for a BIS licence? | Unnamed: 2: The manufacturer must have the requisite manufacturing infrastructure, appropriate process controls, quality control and testing capabilities as per the relevant Indian Standard, and the product must conform to all requirements laid down in that standard.
row 8: BIS Product Certification — Official FAQ (28 Q&A): Q5 | Unnamed: 1: How does BIS grant the licence? | Unnamed: 2: BIS assesses manufacturing infrastructure, process controls, quality control and testing capabilities via a factory visit, and establishes conformity to the standard through third-party lab testing, in-factory testing, or both.

row 18: BIS Product Certification — Official FAQ (28 Q&A): Q15 | Unnamed: 1: What is the timeline for grant of a BIS product certification licence? | Unnamed: 2: Generally about one month under Option-2 and about four months under Option-1 from receipt of a complete application, subject to delays in queries, inspections, sample deposition, and fee dues.

row 23: BIS Product Certification — Official FAQ (28 Q&A): Q20 | Unnamed: 1: What is deferment of a licence, and when does it happen? | Unnamed: 2: Renewal can be deferred under Regulation 8 of the BIS (Conformity Assessment) Regulations, 2018, if the renewal application/fee is not received by the licence's last validity date, or if the licence is under suspension.
row 24: BIS Product Certification — Official FAQ (28 Q&A): Q21 | Unnamed: 1: Does BIS carry out surveillance on my licence regularly? | Unnamed: 2: Yes — surprise factory surveillance inspections verify continued infrastructure, process controls, quality control, testing capability and product conformity; BIS also conducts market surveillance by purchasing ISI-marked samples for third-party testing.
row 25: BIS Product Certification — Official FAQ (28 Q&A): Q22 | Unnamed: 1: What are the duties of a licence holder regarding factory surveillance? | Unnamed: 2: Extend cooperation to BIS/agent personnel, share relevant records, facilitate in-factory testing and sample drawal, and deposit samples to the designated laboratory as advised.
row 26: BIS Product Certification — Official FAQ (28 Q&A): Q23/Q24 | Unnamed: 1: Can one product licence be used for all varieties made at the factory? | Unnamed: 2: No — one licence covers one product/one Indian Standard (though it may cover multiple varieties/grades/sizes specified in the standard); use is limited to the 'Scope of licence' granted. row 27: BIS Product Certification — Official FAQ (28 Q&A): Q25 | Unnamed: 1: What is the procedure for intimating a change of address or shifting of the manufacturing unit? | Unnamed: 2: The licensee must inform BIS of the intended shift with documents for the new premises, suspend use of the Standard Mark on relocation (with intimation to BIS), and BIS revokes the suspension after verifying old/new premises per Scheme-I paragraph 11(3)&(4).
row 28: BIS Product Certification — Official FAQ (28 Q&A): Q26 | Unnamed: 1: When can a licence be suspended? | Unnamed: 2: Under paragraph 11 of Scheme-I and Regulation 10 of the BIS (Conformity Assessment) Regulations, 2018.
row 29: BIS Product Certification — Official FAQ (28 Q&A): Q27 | Unnamed: 1: When can a licence be cancelled? | Unnamed: 2: Under Regulation 11 of the BIS (Conformity Assessment) Regulations, 2018.
row 30: BIS Product Certification — Official FAQ (28 Q&A): Q28 | Unnamed: 1: How can a BIS licensee participate in standard formulation/revision? | Unnamed: 2: By becoming a member of the relevant technical committee, or by sending comments to the concerned technical department via mail or the BIS website.
